questions.whyAsked: The study requires participants to be between 18 and 75 years old.
questions.earlyStopReason: An age outside 18-75 means the patient does not meet inclusion criterion INC-001.

questions.questionText: Are you currently pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant during the study period?
questions.whyAsked: The study excludes patients who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy.
questions.earlyStopReason: A 'Yes' answer means the patient is likely ineligible due to exclusion criterion EXC-002.

questions.questionText: Are you able to understand and provide informed consent for this study?
questions.whyAsked: Participants must be able to provide informed consent before joining the study.
questions.earlyStopReason: A 'No' answer means the patient cannot meet inclusion criterion INC-005.

questions.questionText: Are you able to attend study visits regularly over a 24-week period?
questions.whyAsked: The study requires attendance at all visits across a 24-week treatment period.

questions.questionText: Are you currently taking insulin, or are you unsure about your current diabetes medications?
options: Not sure / unsure of current medications
questions.whyAsked: Current insulin use is an exclusion criterion for this study.
questions.earlyStopReason: A 'Yes, taking insulin' answer may indicate likely ineligibility due to exclusion criterion EXC-004. An uncertain answer flags the case for clinical review.

questions.questionText: Have you ever been diagnosed with Type 1 Diabetes?
questions.whyAsked: A history of Type 1 Diabetes is an exclusion criterion for this study.
questions.earlyStopReason: A 'Yes' answer may indicate likely ineligibility due to exclusion criterion EXC-001.

questions.questionText: Have you been diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes for at least 6 months?
questions.whyAsked: The study requires a documented Type 2 Diabetes diagnosis of at least 6 months.
questions.earlyStopReason: A 'No' answer may indicate the patient does not meet inclusion criterion INC-002.

questions.questionText: Have you been told you have severe kidney (renal) impairment?
questions.whyAsked: Severe renal impairment is an exclusion criterion for this study.
questions.earlyStopReason: A 'Yes' answer may indicate likely ineligibility due to exclusion criterion EXC-003.

questions.questionText: Do you know your most recent HbA1c result, and was it between 7.0% and 10.0%?
questions.whyAsked: The study requires a recent HbA1c result between 7.0% and 10.0%.

questions.questionText: Do you have any known drug allergies relevant to diabetes medications?
questions.whyAsked: A known hypersensitivity to the study drug or its ingredients is an exclusion criterion.
questions.earlyStopReason: A 'Yes' answer may indicate likely ineligibility due to exclusion criterion EXC-005.

suppressedDuplicateCriteria.reason: Age was already asked in the Demographics section.
Pregnancy/breastfeeding status was already asked in the Demographics section.
Informed consent capability was already asked in the Demographics section.
Visit availability was already asked in the Demographics section.

sequencingRationale: Demographics are asked first, including age, pregnancy status, consent capability, and visit availability, since these can quickly resolve or disqualify several criteria early. The Criteria section then mixes high-priority exclusion criteria (insulin use, Type 1 Diabetes history, renal impairment) with essential inclusion criteria (Type 2 Diabetes diagnosis duration, HbA1c range) so that high-impact disqualifying questions are asked before lower-priority ones, rather than grouping all inclusion criteria before all exclusion criteria.
